summary_en: On November 13, 2026, the board resolved to acquire up to 1,800,000 shares (0.46% of outstanding shares) at 2,799 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 16, 2026, with total acquisition cost capped at 5,038.2 million yen. All acquired shares will be cancelled on November 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction transaction (ToSTNeT-3) and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, MatsukiyoCocokara & Co.'s board of directors resolved to acquire up to 1,800,000 shares of its common stock at a fixed price of 2,799 yen per share, calculated from the closing price on that date. The acquisition will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction transaction) on November 16, 2026, with a maximum total consideration of 5,038.2 million yen. This represents 0.46% of outstanding shares as of September 30, 2026 (393,993,938 shares excluding treasury stock).

The company stated that this acquisition is intended to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns as a key management priority. All shares acquired will be cancelled on November 30, 2026, to eliminate any future dilution concerns. The purchase order is valid only for the specified trading session on November 16, 2026, and partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions.
